params.body:
The Sources page side of "read for inspiration only" (pipeline and Standard PRs of the same name). A post on gentells.com never cites, links or names such a source; the Observatory keeps reading it.

- A source tile shows "inspiration only". The source panel says who marked it and when, explains it once, and offers "Read for inspiration only" or "Citable again".
- The rows of the New Sources G. queue get the same link, so a proposed publisher such as YPulse can be marked without being followed.
- The link posts to `/api/pipeline/sources/<id>/use`, refreshes the list, and shows the server's refusal in plain words. It is hidden for guests.
- Fix: the New Sources G. block from #106 tested `s.lifecycle === 'proposed'`, but the sources list sends `state`, so the block never appeared. It now reads `state`.

e2e: `e2e/inspiration.spec.js` (4); full suite 48/48; build passes.
params.title: Sources: mark a source as read for inspiration only
